gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC looks scribbled in one steady line. Noto Sans Coptic is the sans-serif that follows, with a dominant middle zone and open mouths on the s and c, so it feels tidy beside that handwriting.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Amatic SC draws every diagonal as stout as every upright, like toothpaste squeezed out in a line. And Noto Sans Cuneiform, a sans-serif with puffed, bead-like lowercase and an open e, keeps a long read feeling soft and easy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Amatic SC lends a casual, hand-lettered look. Its curves and stems move in lockstep, which is its gift for display, while Noto Sans Deseret does the quieter work with wide-looking lowercase and open apertures that stay legible.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari brings a plain sans with an open-curved g and a compact skyline where capitals melt into lowercase. Amatic SC, traced as if by one marker tip, adds the wobble.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Duployan is a plain sans. Its strongest quality is the wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, which sit nicely against Amatic SC's thick-only, quirky outlines.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Rustic, scrawled, a bit cheeky. Noto Sans Elbasan then takes over what Amatic SC, with its swell-free marker stroke, starts, offering large lowercase and open terminals that never pinch shut for the body of the text.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic is a modern sans with a tall, sturdy lowercase and c terminals that hang far from the bowl. But Amatic SC is the one with personality, since its thickness never shifts with direction and it feels hand-lettered.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Hand-lettered, bent-pipe charm up top. Amatic SC holds a constant stroke width for attitude, and Noto Sans Georgian is the sans below it, its open curves and short ascender stems making the strongest case for clarity.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Noto Sans Glagolitic is a sans-serif with round, open letters and a tall, sturdy body that stays clear even small. Amatic SC wants generous size for its gauge-uniform strokes.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Amatic SC has the steady line of a drafting pen, yet it still looks hand-made. Noto Sans Gothic, a sans-serif with glass-bead counters and parenthesis-like rounds, feels spacious and sleek next to it.
